title: The Genie One Chrome extension is in Beta
body: The Genie One Chrome extension is now available in [Beta](/aws/en/release-notes/release-types). The extension makes every new Chrome tab open Genie One in your workspace, so asking a question, searching across your tools, or opening a dashboard takes one click. Install it from the Chrome Web Store. See [Use Genie One as your Chrome new tab page](/aws/en/genie-one/chrome-extension).
